lyrics:
[Intro: ticking clock, soft piano, synth pad]

[Verse 1: female voice, hushed]
It's midnight and the house is still
The phone is face down on the sill
I turned it over twice to see
A grown woman, fifty-one. That's me.

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, voice lifting]
I'd put all this away
In a box marked "that was then"

[Chorus: full band explodes, voice at full power]
I forgot it felt like this
My heart's a kid again
Hands are shaking, can't sit still
I'm counting hours till when
How do I get through the night
Till you write back to me?
I forgot it felt like this
I forgot it could be me

[Verse 2: hushed again, piano and clock]
I've raised two children, buried one man
I've run a house, I've made a plan
And none of that is any use
When someone's laugh has cut me loose

[Pre-Chorus: bass and drums build]
I thought the fire went with the years
It was only waiting

[Chorus: full band, voice at full power]
I forgot it felt like this
My heart's a kid again
Hands are shaking, can't sit still
I'm counting hours till when
How do I get through the night
Till you write back to me?
I forgot it felt like this
I forgot it could be me

[Guitar Solo: soaring, melodic]

[Bridge: band drops, a phone buzzes, voice breathless]
Oh. Oh, that's him.

[Final Chorus: biggest, top note held]
I forgot it felt like this
My heart's a kid again
Hands are shaking, can't sit still
I'm counting hours till when
I don't have to get through the night
You wrote right back to me
I forgot it felt like this
And I'm so glad it's me

[Outro: clock ticking, typing, a small laugh]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 88 BPM, 4/4, B minor verses and D major choruses. Hushed and tense, then enormous.

VOICE: Female, one of those big rock voices: breathy and close in the verses, then a full-throated wail at the top of her range in the choruses, with a held high note at the end. One breathless spoken line in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: Piano, a ticking clock, a warm synth pad, bass, a huge 1980s drum kit that enters with the chorus, layered electric guitars, a soaring lead guitar solo, a second harmony vocal in the choruses.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, clock and piano. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:44 Pre-chorus. 0:54 Chorus 1. 1:26 Verse 2. 1:56 Pre-chorus. 2:06 Chorus 2. 2:38 Guitar solo. 2:54 Bridge, the buzz. 3:02 Final chorus. 3:36 Outro, typing and a laugh, ends 3:48.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1980s arena ballad: very quiet verses, huge reverberant choruses, guitars and drums like a wall.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The phone buzzing in the silence at 2:54.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young woman's first secret longing. The same sleepless night at fifty-one is funnier and braver, and this one ends with a reply.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Embarrassed, thrilled, undone, delighted.
